original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.

actual_scope: For the shortest six-label equation F1+...+F6=4I, classify target support and prove that every rational support solution fails the inherited character inequality.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a larger or nonabelian native alphabet. This package stays in the abelian symmetric 2-by-2 model and answers the six-frame question left open by the five-frame support note, for the single shortest once-each equation with no old call. It is a scoped local result, not another construction round.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the signed-frame escape. The six-call equation admits support but no word, so there is no local call-count saving and no selected-frontier change.
stop_rule: Stop after the six-frame support classification and the character obstruction on that locus. Do not start five frames plus one old call, six frames plus an old call, or seven or more frames.
evidence: Census: 658 column orbits of the 230300 subset 4-tuples. Outside two orbits, 4224 systems are inconsistent and 11552 have a re-expanded degree-1 certificate of 1. The four-cycle orbit is {A,B,P,Q} plus a trace-2 rank-one splitting of 2I. The four-triple orbit has no real point. Every family member fails chi_AB, 2 calls against 4 targets. Witness A,P,B,Q,2A,2B meets support and is not a word. Inherited determinant and subset-sum necessity are not reproved.

open_questions.question: Can five added signed rank-one frames plus one old call meet support at length 6?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The six-frame theorem uses residual 4I. A word at length 6 with one old call would lower the eight-call minimum.
open_questions.first_step: Fix one old projector E and five primitive directions summing to 4I-E, then test one rational rank-one solution for target support.
open_questions.blocked_by: The size cut and the character count both use six new frames and residual 4I. One old call changes the residual.

open_questions.question: Can seven or more added signed rank-one frames, or six frames plus an old call, lower the eight-call minimum?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The classification stops at six once-each frames with no old call. A longer pure added-frame word could still exist.
open_questions.first_step: Fix seven primitive directions and the shortest determinant equation that uses each new label once.
open_questions.blocked_by: No seven-frame size cut or character reduction is supplied, and an old call changes the residual.
